# odinex_network (Data Source)

Looks up a private network by ID, name or label selector.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "odinex_network" "private" {
  name = "private"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `id` (Number) ID of the network.
- `name` (String) Name of the network.
- `with_selector` (String) Label selector, e.g. `env=prod,role`.

### Read-Only

- `delete_protection` (Boolean) Whether delete protection is on.
- `gateway` (String) Address kept for a NAT gateway: the first host of the range.
- `ip_range` (String) IP range.
- `labels` (Map of String) Labels.
- `location` (String) Location.
- `nat_gateway_id` (Number) ID of the network's NAT gateway, if any.
- `servers` (List of Number) IDs of attached servers.
